prs.title: feat(evaluator): make toJSON(steps) return nested steps object
prs.body:
## Summary

- `toJSON(steps)` was returning `null` instead of the nested `{ step_id: { outputs: {...}, outcome, conclusion } }` object that GitHub Actions provides
- Added a `"steps" if parts.len() == 1` match arm in `resolve()` that builds a nested `ExprValue::Object` from both `step_outputs` and `step_statuses` maps
- Unions keys from both maps so steps appearing in either are included

## Test plan

- [x] `tojson_steps_returns_nested_object` — full nested structure with outputs + statuses
- [x] `tojson_steps_empty_context` — empty steps → `{}`
- [x] `tojson_steps_sorted_keys` — alphabetical key ordering
- [x] `tojson_steps_status_without_outputs` — step with outcome/conclusion but empty outputs
- [x] `tojson_steps_outputs_without_status` — step with outputs but no status entry
- [x] `bare_steps_is_truthy` — bare `steps` with data is truthy
- [x] `tojson_steps_special_characters_in_outputs` — quotes, backslashes, unicode in output values
- [x] All 59 expression tests pass
